meta.register: Ryhti building addresses (successor of DVV Rakennusten osoitetiedot)
meta.notes: DVV stopped publishing its building address file on 14.3.2025 and handed the building register to Syke's Ryhti, so this is Ryhti's open_address layer (retired addresses are a separate layer, not read); id is address_key; point is the building's point, EPSG:3067 transformed to EPSG:4326 with pyproj; house_number is number, letter and the second number or letter of a range as the register joins them; road and postal office in Finnish, Swedish where the register has no Finnish; postal office written as the register writes it (capitals) as city; no unit or estimated flag exists in the register
meta.draw: lowest sha256('2026:' || register id) among eligible rows

forms.messy: same, without postcode, region and country, abbreviated by OpenCage's lists

meta.truth: the register's point, converted to WGS84 by PROJ where the register uses another CRS

operations.EPSG:3067: Inverse of TM35FIN + ETRS89 to WGS 84 (1) + axis order change (2D)
